title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1981-05-09
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Doug Lamarre; arista mics > sony d5; maxell xl-II90’s, dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark adc1 24/96; transferred & seeded by Rob Berger 10/2017

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience recording of a solid show with enjoyable “Eyes”
ai_review.review: The audience tape is surprisingly clear for a crowd source, letting the cheers add atmosphere while keeping the music audible. The performance isn’t highlighted by any standout moments according to the reviewer, but it’s described as a good overall show and the rendition of “Eyes” was especially enjoyed.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review praises both the recording quality for an audience source and the overall show, though no detailed musical analysis is provided.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear for an audience tape; crowd cheering adds ambience, no major flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally solid pacing with no specific issues mentioned.
